notes.title: Our Freedom exclusive Demo Update for Ukrainian Game Festival!
notes.content:
[p]Hello Gamers!
We’ve prepared an [b]exclusive Demo update[/b] packed with exciting improvements:[/p][p][/p][p]1. Added new farming crops.[/p][p]2. Added the ability to manually plant crops, apply fertilizer, and harvest them.[/p][p]3. Added the ability to chop down trees with an axe.[/p][p]4. Added a gathering mechanic — the world now contains berry bushes and medicinal plants to collect.[/p][p]5. Significantly improved the combat system — it is now target-oriented (you can switch back to the old system in settings).[/p][p]6. Reworked construction — you now need to hold a hammer to build planned structures. Villagers also build faster and with better quality. Added new particles and sounds to the building process.[/p][p]7. Added gamepad support.[/p][p]8. Improved many animations, especially object interaction animations.[/p][p]9. Added a windmill and beehives as decorative elements (in the future, they will be interactive).[/p][p]10. Significantly improved NPC behaviour — they navigate better, find paths faster, and get stuck in walls less often.[/p][p]11. Added quick actions in trading — holding Ctrl now adds 5 items to the cart.[/p][p]12. Added a QuickBar system — you can now place food, tools, and equipment in the quick access bar for fast use when needed.[/p][p]13. Overhauled lighting system, significantly improving game optimization and atmosphere.[/p][p]14. Other improvements — sounds, lighting, interface, world, and buildings.

Wishlist on Steam and Follow us on [u][url="https://x.com/CodeMyGod1"]X/Twitter[/url][/u]! This is the best way to support our game.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2758190/Our_Freedom/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
